I have completed the independent review of the invoice list product without modifying any product files. The release verdict has been written to [REVIEW.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-e0Q8jO/workspace/REVIEW.md).

### Release Verdict: **BLOCK**

### Summary of What Was Verified

1. **Product & UX Contract Alignment**: Verified `public/app.js` against `PRODUCT.md` and `ux-walkthrough.md`. The front-end lacks sign-in/sign-out controls and empty/error states, and crashes with an uncaught `TypeError` on load due to unauthenticated requests to `/api/invoices`.
2. **Automated & Static Security Testing**: Ran `npm test` (passed 1 test) and `npm run check:backend` (failed due to invalid JSON syntax in `checker.config.json`). Audited `public/app.js` and confirmed hardcoded client-facing tokens (`MAPS_EMBED_KEY`, `BILLING_API_TOKEN`).
3. **Acceptance Gate & Architecture**: Ran the independent product acceptance check script (`accept-check.js`), which flagged missing trust documentation in `ARCHITECTURE.md` and missing health/operability endpoints.
